Step: 1052 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception because 1052 mod 100 ≠ 0).  
Days from Apr 24 to end of April: 6 days.  
May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) + Sep (30) = 153 days.  
Total so far: 6 + 153 = 159 days.  
Remaining from 219: 219 − 159 = 60 days to add after Sep 30.  
Oct 31 → 30 days left, Nov 30 → 0 days left → date is Nov 30, 1052.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1052-11-30
